title: Systems of meaning

source.dataset: psychonautwiki_db.zip (psychonautwiki.db, SQLite export provided by Hany, file dated 2026-11-25)

plain_text:
A system of meaning is two things simultaneously: (1) a model of the world and (2) a model for acting in that world. Due to the fact that these several systems of meaning have existed and arisen throughout history, it ought to be believed that all systems of meaning are incomplete in their descriptive capacity. Unfortunately, that is a system of meaning in itself. 

This page lists and describes the various systems of meaning to explore when undergoing suggestibility and spirituality intensifications, which can occur under the influence of entheogenic compounds.

Absurdism

Daoism

Hedonism

Nihilism

Political

Religious

Self-made
